To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a Resizable Mini-batched Gradient Descent based Multi-Armed bandit can improve the performance of mini-batch gradient descend in deep learning.

RMGD is a novel algorithm for determining the appropriate batch size in mini-batch gradient decent that is based on a multi armed bandit and that RMGD outperforms the best performing single size batch size and achieves this performance faster than the grid search method.
RMGD can be used to achieve the best performance in grid searching by selecting an appropriate mini-batch size at each epoch based on the previous success/failure.
